zin_magical_forest_recruit = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_character = 1 }
			NOT = { has_character = zin_magical_forest_perlan }
		}
		recruit_character = zin_magical_forest_perlan
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_character = 2 }
			NOT = { has_character = zin_magical_forest_ithrandel }
		}
		recruit_character = zin_magical_forest_ithrandel
	}
}

zin_magical_forest_rift_watch = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_elves_is_rift_realm = yes
			OR = {
				is_in_faction_with = ROOT
				has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -1 }
			}
		}
		random_owned_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_rift_west = yes }
			add_building_construction = {
				type = coastal_bunker
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
				province = {
					all_provinces = yes
					limit_to_coastal = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_rift_west = yes } }
		random_owned_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_rift_west = yes }
			add_building_construction = {
				type = coastal_bunker
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
				province = {
					all_provinces = yes
					limit_to_coastal = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_value (number).
zin_magical_forest_purge_footholds = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_arg_value }
	zin_afrit_add_footholds = yes
	every_other_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
			is_in_faction_with = ROOT
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = ROOT.zin_arg_value }
		zin_afrit_add_footholds = yes
	}
}

zin_magical_forest_wargoal_on_invader = {
	random_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
		ROOT = {
			create_wargoal = {
				type = puppet_wargoal_focus
				target = PREV
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_magical_forest_join_war_against_dark = {
	random_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes
			has_war = yes
		}
		save_global_event_target_as = zin_magical_forest_dark_foe
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_event_target = zin_magical_forest_dark_foe }
		event_target:zin_magical_forest_dark_foe = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_enemy_country = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes } }
				random_enemy_country = {
					limit = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_magical_forest_dark_friend
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_enemy_country = { zin_eindil_is_host = yes } }
				random_enemy_country = {
					limit = { zin_eindil_is_host = yes }
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_magical_forest_dark_friend
				}
			}
			else = {
				random_enemy_country = {
					limit = { has_government = democratic }
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_magical_forest_dark_friend
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_event_target = zin_magical_forest_dark_friend }
			add_to_war = {
				targeted_alliance = global_event_target:zin_magical_forest_dark_friend
				enemy = global_event_target:zin_magical_forest_dark_foe
				hostility_reason = asked_to_join
			}
		}
	}
}
